evidence.statedText: 5th Edition AAPG/EAGE Hydrocarbon Seals of the Middle East GTW, 28-30 September 2026, Kuwait City, Kuwait

program.text: 3-day workshop. Objectives: move beyond thickness-only seal evaluation to cover rock mineralogy/lithofacies, brittle-ductile behavior, hydrocarbon phase/column height, structural reactivation/tilted fluid contacts, pressure regimes, CO2 storage seal assessment. Themes: regional/intraformational seals with field analogues; sequence stratigraphy/facies/diagenesis vs seal development; seal architecture in carbonate/evaporite/siliciclastic/mixed sequences; static & dynamic sealing capacity; integrating petrophysical/rock mechanics/seismic/engineering data; structural geology & geomechanics impact on seals; fault seal capacity; CCS seal evaluation. Oral presentations and posters.

themes: structural geology & geomechanics impact on seals
